from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u018/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p=base/'task-dba799f2.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    def flip_h(a):
        return [row[::-1] for row in a]
    def flip_v(a):
        return a[::-1]
    def rotate180(a):
        return [row[::-1] for row in a[::-1]]
    tiles = [
        [rotate180(grid), flip_v(grid), rotate180(grid)],
        [flip_h(grid), grid, flip_h(grid)],
        [rotate180(grid), flip_v(grid), rotate180(grid)],
    ]
    return [sum((tiles[tr][tc][r] for tc in range(3)), [])
            for tr in range(3) for r in range(h)]
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code, str(p), 'exec'), globals())
demos=[([[7,6,7],[2,7,6],[1,2,7]], [[7,2,1,1,2,7,7,2,1],[6,7,2,2,7,6,6,7,2],[7,6,7,7,6,7,7,6,7],[7,6,7,7,6,7,7,6,7],[6,7,2,2,7,6,6,7,2],[7,2,1,1,2,7,7,2,1],[7,2,1,1,2,7,7,2,1],[6,7,2,2,7,6,6,7,2],[7,6,7,7,6,7,7,6,7]]), ([[6,1,7],[1,6,7],[4,7,4]], [[4,7,4,4,7,4,4,7,4],[7,6,1,1,6,7,7,6,1],[7,1,6,6,1,7,7,1,6],[7,1,6,6,1,7,7,1,6],[7,6,1,1,6,7,7,6,1],[4,7,4,4,7,4,4,7,4],[4,7,4,4,7,4,4,7,4],[7,6,1,1,6,7,7,6,1],[7,1,6,6,1,7,7,1,6]])]
print('pair_matches', [transform(x)==y for x,y in demos])
test=[[8,8,6],[6,3,6],[6,8,8]]
